name: OpenMotion (formerly html-anything)
description: Make motion videos with your coding agent: recreate reference clips, edit HTML scenes in a local studio and render MP4, with an MCP server, skills and 200+ templates.

skills.name: Template to Video
skills.description: Finds a motion template in the local catalog, inspects its guide and creates an editable project copy for your content.

skills.name: Recreate a Reference
skills.description: Reconstructs a reference video's shots, timing and transitions as an editable HTML project and compares the result.

skills.name: Original Films
skills.description: Plans original films covering narrative, movement and sound, and runs a creative review of the result.

skills.name: Edit and Export
skills.description: Makes scoped edits, previews and checks HTML scenes, troubleshoots issues and exports the finished video.

skills.name: Video to Template
skills.description: Turns a finished video project into a portable, reusable template with its Motion.md style guide.
